brief.text: Cluster thesis STRENGTHENING (early), live 2026-09-21, restored from intact (09-14). Reason: 800G->1.6T is supply-constrained at the laser; LITE and COHR ship 1.6T now, and NVDA invests in laser/photonics capacity. Ladder LITE > COHR > ALAB > APH > MRVL > CIEN > GLW (APH promoted above MRVL; CIEN 6, GLW laggard). Margin pool is moving toward laser/EML supply, away from module assembly and passive materials. Falsifier: a 1.6T module order cut or laser build pause, or EML lead times shortening into November prints. Reorder triggers: COHR volume 200G/lane by 11-06; GLW ATM use 10-27; APH AI above ~35% on 10-28; MRVL 12-02. KEY: Strengthening (early), 2026-09-21 [secondary]; Ladder LITE > COHR > ALAB > APH > MRVL > CIEN > GLW; Margin pool toward laser/EML supply; Any named in-house NIC/switch ASIC lowers MRVL and ALAB together; Bench: AVGO, CRDO versus MRVL. OPEN: Does COHR disclose volume 200G/lane EML shipments by 2026-11-06?; Does GLW disclose ATM usage above ~$500M on 10-27?; Does APH disclose AI above ~35% of revenue on 10-28?.
